statement: Both all-prime cusp assertions for odd-abelian extensions of the dihedral, quaternion and semidihedral two-group families
notes: Registered after full root and DE proof/source audits PASS; exact A71–A73 certificates are reused, with no new numerical inference. Coprime subgroups and quotient kernels split. Proper quaternion/semidihedral quotients factor through their dihedral central quotients, so every actual two-group factor is in the settled families or abelian. The exact A71 actual connected fibre product, Abel-map extension, separate nilpotent tree theorem and literal rational-subtree lifting apply unchanged. No new rank-zero assertion for the pullback Jacobian, no product of two nonabelian Sylows, and no universal A5 conclusion.
